carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge (lateral keel) is visible along the posterior flank leading to the caudal peduncle, defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity highlights on the superior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, small dark circular mark or lesion is visible on the mid-flank, positioned anteriorly to the base of the second dorsal fin.
